games.name: Zoomies
games.tagline: Gallop through the house for biscuits and mice.
howTo: Swipe up or down to change lane.
Tap to jump over things, hold to slide under them.
Catnip pulls biscuits in; a box takes one bump.

games.name: Catapult
games.tagline: Pounce the toy mice off their towers.
howTo: Drag back anywhere, aim, and let go: the further back, the harder the pounce.
Knock every toy mouse to the ground, or pounce right on it.

games.name: Purrfect Match
games.tagline: Swap toys to line up three or more.
howTo: Swap two toys side by side to make a line of three.
Four in a line makes a paw swipe, an L makes a box, five makes the laser dot.
Match on dust to clear it, and beside parcels to open them.

games.name: Cats in a Row
games.tagline: Get four in a row before the other cat does.
howTo: Tap a column to drop your counter in.
Four in a line wins: along, up or slanting.
Beat each cat to meet the next.

opponents.name: Biscuit
opponents.meet: Biscuit wants to play. Biscuit always wants to play.
opponents.wins: Biscuit is delighted. Again? Biscuit says again.
opponents.loses: Biscuit loses happily and asks for another go.

opponents.name: Clover
opponents.meet: Clover has come in from the garden to play.
opponents.wins: Clover purrs and settles in for another round.
opponents.loses: Clover nods politely and heads back to the blossom.

opponents.name: Bram
opponents.meet: Bram looks at the board as if he owns it.
opponents.wins: Bram blinks slowly. He knew all along.
opponents.loses: Bram pretends he was not really trying.

opponents.name: Nata
opponents.meet: Nata has a plan. Nata always has a plan.
opponents.wins: Nata does a lap of the room. Twice.
opponents.loses: Nata swats a counter off the table and leaves.

opponents.name: Mango
opponents.meet: Mango is ready. Mango was born ready.
opponents.wins: Mango gets the zoomies. Victory zoomies.
opponents.loses: Mango sulks for a moment, then wants a rematch.

opponents.name: Juniper
opponents.meet: Juniper settles beside the board and waits for you.
opponents.loses: Juniper is impressed, and a little sleepy.

opponents.name: Saffron
opponents.meet: Saffron has been waiting in the sun for a worthy match.
opponents.wins: Saffron tilts her head. A good game, she allows.
opponents.loses: Saffron gives you a long, respectful look.

opponents.name: Pat
opponents.meet: Pat taught all the others. Good luck.
opponents.wins: Pat purrs. You were close. Come back soon.
opponents.loses: You beat Pat! Pat is very proud of you.
